Dear Sir/Madam, 
Sub: Intimation under Regulations 30  of the SEBI (Listing Obligations and Disclosure Requirements) 
Regulations, 2015 ("SEBI Listing Regulations") regarding initiation of Forensic Audit 
Ref: SSFL/Stock Exchange/2026-27/082 dated November 02, 2026 
In furtherance of the aforementioned intimation, wherein the Company informed the Stock Exchanges about a cyber 
fraud incident involving unauthorised transactions from one of its bank accounts on November 1, 2026, aggregating 
to approximately ₹7.80 crore and transferred to multiple beneficiary accounts. It is to inform that the Company has 
engaged PKF Consulting Services LLP for initiating forensic audit and investigation into the cybersecurity incident 
identified on November 1, 2026. 
The details as required under Schedule III, Part A of the SEBI Listing Regulations are provided below: 
• Name of the entity initiating the forensic audit: Spandana Sphoorty Financial Limited 
• Reasons for the forensic audit:  To undertake an independent forensic investigation to ascertain the root 
cause of the incident and recommend appropriate remedial and preventive measures to strengthen the 
Company’s cybersecurity framework. 
 
The Company confirms that its business operations are continuing as usual and that the incident has not had any 
material impact on its business operations. 
 
The aforesaid intimation will also be made available on the website of the Company at www.spandanasphoorty.com. 
 
This is for your information and record.  
 
Thanking you 
 
Yours Sincerely, 
For Spandana Sphoorty Financial Limited  
 
Vinay Prakash Tripathi 
Company Secretary

Pursuant to Regulation 30 of the SEBI (Listing Obligations and Disclosure Requirements) Regulations, 
2015, we wish to inform you that VALSANG DRIVEHUB PRIVATE LIMITED has been incorporated on 
November 6, 2026 under the Companies Act, 2013. Dhruv Consultancy Services Limited has subscribed

Regulations, 2015, we wish to inform you that Prestige Estates Projects Limited (“the 
Company”) has entered into Share Purchase Agreement on November 6, 2026 to acquire 
100% stake in Allure Developers Private Limited (“Allure”). 
 
With this acquisition, Allure has become a wholly owned subsidiary of the Company. Allure 
is undertaking development of a residential project in Noida, NCR.
